reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-09-09 against the 2026-09-01T23:59:59Z reserve snapshot (the yield-comparison clock is a separate daily refresh and is not reserve freshness). The leveraged book is expressed gross, never net: gross long positions total $1,024,715,743.45 across Stablecoins ($1,004,786,422.72), Other ($19,921,859.53), ETH/derivatives ($4,780.33), AVAX/derivatives ($2,676.97) and BTC/derivatives ($3.90), while gross debt totals $891,966,994.74 including $19,914,992.49 of perpetual shorts, with net NAV $132,748,763.37 and leverage coverage 114.88%. Percentages below normalize the long categories to the gross-long total; the ETH/AVAX/BTC derivative longs round below slice precision and fold into the altcoin bucket. Netting the $892m debt into 'stablecoins' would hide material leverage, so debt is published as separate disclosure totals and never enters the slices.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Avant Protocol avUSD transparency API gross long positions dated 2026-09-01, normalized to the gross-long total; gross debt and net NAV carried as disclosure totals
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Gross long legs are strategy positions, not a reconciled holder-exitable allocation by tracked stablecoin; the issuer reports $17,318,101.27 in bridge positions whose venue chains are not itemized and marks some USDC/HYPE positions with an unknown chain. Counterparty, custody and rehypothecation terms remain unresolved.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The API reports gross long legs spanning USDe, syrupUSDT, syrupUSDC, USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD and other tokens with matching debt legs, but no reconciled holder-exitable allocation by tracked stablecoin; the long legs are strategy positions of a leveraged book.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The live API shows assets deployed across Aave, Morpho, Kamino, Curvance, Jupiter, Ethena, Euler, Silo and other DeFi protocols, plus bridges/exchanges and treasury wallets. Avant docs state strategies are executed on-chain and with partners such as 0xPartners, but do not disclose legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms.
